title: Where Constraints Live: code for the MSc dissertation (inverse CSG and geometric dissection)
description: Code accompanying the MSc dissertation 'Where Constraints Live: Representation in Inverse CSG and Geometric Dissection' (UNICAMP, 2026): typed-slot primitive competition for inverse CSG and the budget sweep of Chapter 3; lattice search, common-boundary optimisation (BACO), the shared patch complex and its numerical validation for geometric dissection in Chapter 5.
